description: This Java class defines a custom layout component named FractionalLinearLayout that extends LinearLayout. It allows position animations based on a fraction of the screen height, useful for fragment animations where runtime dimension calculation is necessary.

classes.name: FractionalLinearLayout
classes.description: A custom LinearLayout subclass designed to facilitate animations of its position based on a fractional height of the device's screen.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the view with a context.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Overrides the method to capture screen height when size changes and set initial Y position to the bottom of the screen.

methods.name: getYFraction
methods.description: Returns the current vertical position as a fraction of the total height.

methods.name: setYFraction
methods.description: Sets the view's Y position based on a provided fractional value of the screen height.
